lines.text: Four brackets, all multiplied together. Do you really have to multiply it all out?
lines.caption: Four brackets, all multiplied together. Do you really have to multiply it all out?

lines.text: Most kids start multiplying, and the numbers explode. <short pause> But there's a trick that makes it collapse!
lines.caption: Most kids start multiplying, and the numbers explode. But there's a trick that makes it collapse!

lines.text: Hi, I'm Vantee! Let's find out how.
lines.caption: Hi, I'm Vantee! Let's find out how.

lines.text: Here's the question.
lines.caption: Here's the question.

lines.text: What is one plus one over two, times one plus one over four,
lines.caption: What is one plus one over two, times one plus one over four,

lines.text: times one plus one over sixteen, times one plus one over two hundred fifty-six?
lines.caption: times one plus one over sixteen, times one plus one over two hundred fifty-six?

lines.text: Here are the five choices. Some of these numbers are huge!
lines.caption: Here are the five choices. Some of these numbers are huge!

lines.text: So what are we really looking for?
lines.caption: So what are we really looking for?

lines.text: Four brackets, each one plus a fraction. We multiply them all.
lines.caption: Four brackets, each one plus a fraction. We multiply them all.

lines.text: Look at the bottom numbers: two, four, sixteen, two hundred fifty-six.
lines.caption: Look at the bottom numbers: two, four, sixteen, two hundred fifty-six.

lines.text: Each one is the one before it, squared!
lines.caption: Each one is the one before it, squared!

lines.text: Two squared is four. Four squared is sixteen. Sixteen squared is two hundred fifty-six.
lines.caption: Two squared is four. Four squared is sixteen. Sixteen squared is two hundred fifty-six.

lines.text: The first bracket is three over two, and the rest are bigger than one.
lines.caption: The first bracket is three over two, and the rest are bigger than one.

lines.text: So the answer is bigger than three over two.
lines.caption: So the answer is bigger than three over two.

lines.text: Now it's your turn. Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!
lines.caption: Now it's your turn. Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!

lines.text: Welcome back! Let's start the honest way: multiply one bracket at a time.
lines.caption: Welcome back! Let's start the honest way: multiply one bracket at a time.

lines.text: One plus one over two is three over two.
lines.caption: One plus one over two is three over two.

lines.text: Times five over four. Three times five is fifteen, and two times four is eight.
lines.caption: Times five over four. Three times five is fifteen, and two times four is eight.

lines.text: So we have fifteen over eight.
lines.caption: So we have fifteen over eight.

lines.text: Times seventeen over sixteen. Fifteen times seventeen is two hundred fifty-five.
lines.caption: Times seventeen over sixteen. Fifteen times seventeen is two hundred fifty-five.

lines.text: Eight times sixteen is one hundred twenty-eight.
lines.caption: Eight times sixteen is one hundred twenty-eight.

lines.text: Now look at the tops: three, fifteen, two hundred fifty-five.
lines.caption: Now look at the tops: three, fifteen, two hundred fifty-five.

lines.text: Each top is ONE less than double its bottom!
lines.caption: Each top is ONE less than double its bottom!

lines.text: So each answer is a little under two.
lines.caption: So each answer is a little under two.

lines.text: Two minus one over two. Two minus one over eight. Two minus one over one hundred twenty-eight.
lines.caption: Two minus one over two. Two minus one over eight. Two minus one over one hundred twenty-eight.

lines.text: Now the last bracket: times two hundred fifty-seven over two hundred fifty-six.
lines.caption: Now the last bracket: times two hundred fifty-seven over two hundred fifty-six.

lines.text: For the new bottom, multiply one hundred twenty-eight by two hundred fifty-six.
lines.caption: For the new bottom, multiply one hundred twenty-eight by two hundred fifty-six.

lines.text: The new top is two hundred fifty-five times two hundred fifty-seven. That's a big one!
lines.caption: The new top is two hundred fifty-five times two hundred fifty-seven. That's a big one!

lines.text: Here's a shortcut. Write it as two hundred fifty-six minus one, times two hundred fifty-six plus one.
lines.caption: Here's a shortcut. Write it as two hundred fifty-six minus one, times two hundred fifty-six plus one.

lines.text: Multiply it out, and the middle parts cancel.
lines.caption: Multiply it out, and the middle parts cancel.

lines.text: So the top is two hundred fifty-six squared, minus one.
lines.caption: So the top is two hundred fifty-six squared, minus one.

lines.text: And two hundred fifty-six squared is exactly double the new bottom.
lines.caption: And two hundred fifty-six squared is exactly double the new bottom.

lines.text: So the top is one less than double the bottom again. The answer is C!
lines.caption: So the top is one less than double the bottom again. The answer is C!

lines.text: Here's a cleverer way, with a helper.
lines.caption: Here's a cleverer way, with a helper.

lines.text: Let's bring in a helper: one minus one over two. That's one over two.
lines.caption: Let's bring in a helper: one minus one over two. That's one over two.

lines.text: One minus one over two, times one plus one over two. That's our shortcut again!
lines.caption: One minus one over two, times one plus one over two. That's our shortcut again!

lines.text: It gives one minus one over four.
lines.caption: It gives one minus one over four.

lines.text: Now one minus one over four meets one plus one over four. That makes one minus one over sixteen.
lines.caption: Now one minus one over four meets one plus one over four. That makes one minus one over sixteen.

lines.text: Next comes one minus one over two hundred fifty-six.
lines.caption: Next comes one minus one over two hundred fifty-six.

lines.text: Last, one minus one over two hundred fifty-six squared.
lines.caption: Last, one minus one over two hundred fifty-six squared.

lines.text: Each step knocks over the next one. The whole chain collapses!
lines.caption: Each step knocks over the next one. The whole chain collapses!

lines.text: Hold on! We multiplied by one over two, so we must undo it. Let's double it!
lines.caption: Hold on! We multiplied by one over two, so we must undo it. Let's double it!

lines.text: Double everything: two, minus two over two hundred fifty-six squared.
lines.caption: Double everything: two, minus two over two hundred fifty-six squared.

lines.text: That's exactly choice C again!
lines.caption: That's exactly choice C again!

lines.text: When would you pick this way? When each bottom is the last one squared.
lines.caption: When would you pick this way? When each bottom is the last one squared.

lines.text: Now let's look at the wrong answers. Each one is a trap.
lines.caption: Now let's look at the wrong answers. Each one is a trap.

lines.text: A is what you get if you forget to undo the helper.
lines.caption: A is what you get if you forget to undo the helper.

lines.text: But A is less than one, and every bracket is bigger than one. It can't be right!
lines.caption: But A is less than one, and every bracket is bigger than one. It can't be right!

lines.text: B stops after three brackets. Don't forget the last one!
lines.caption: B stops after three brackets. Don't forget the last one!

lines.text: D is two, minus ONE over two hundred fifty-six squared. The tiny piece wasn't doubled.
lines.caption: D is two, minus ONE over two hundred fifty-six squared. The tiny piece wasn't doubled.

lines.text: Choice E is two, PLUS two over two hundred fifty-six squared. That's the wrong sign!
lines.caption: Choice E is two, PLUS two over two hundred fifty-six squared. That's the wrong sign!

lines.text: Every bracket is bigger than one, so A is out.
lines.caption: Every bracket is bigger than one, so A is out.

lines.text: And our pattern says the answer is just under two, so E is out.
lines.caption: And our pattern says the answer is just under two, so E is out.

lines.text: Ready for a challenge? Try this one.
lines.caption: Ready for a challenge? Try this one.

lines.text: One plus one over three, times one plus one over nine.
lines.caption: One plus one over three, times one plus one over nine.

lines.text: Use a helper again. But careful: what's the helper this time?
lines.caption: Use a helper again. But careful: what's the helper this time?

lines.text: Pause the video, and go for it!
lines.caption: Pause the video, and go for it!

lines.text: Let's check. The helper is one minus one over three. That's two over three.
lines.caption: Let's check. The helper is one minus one over three. That's two over three.

lines.text: The chain collapses: one minus one over nine, then one minus one over eighty-one.
lines.caption: The chain collapses: one minus one over nine, then one minus one over eighty-one.

lines.text: That's eighty over eighty-one.
lines.caption: That's eighty over eighty-one.

lines.text: Now undo the helper. We multiplied by two over three, so we multiply by three over two.
lines.caption: Now undo the helper. We multiplied by two over three, so we multiply by three over two.

lines.text: That gives two hundred forty over one hundred sixty-two, which is forty over twenty-seven.
lines.caption: That gives two hundred forty over one hundred sixty-two, which is forty over twenty-seven.

lines.text: Doubling out of habit gives one hundred sixty over eighty-one. That's too big!
lines.caption: Doubling out of habit gives one hundred sixty over eighty-one. That's too big!

lines.text: Check it the honest way: four over three, times ten over nine is forty over twenty-seven.
lines.caption: Check it the honest way: four over three, times ten over nine is forty over twenty-seven.

lines.text: If you got forty over twenty-seven, amazing work!
lines.caption: If you got forty over twenty-seven, amazing work!

lines.text: Here's the big idea to remember.
lines.caption: Here's the big idea to remember.

lines.text: When each bottom is the last one squared, bring in a helper: one minus the first fraction.
lines.caption: When each bottom is the last one squared, bring in a helper: one minus the first fraction.

lines.text: Each pair turns into one minus a square, and the chain collapses. Then undo the helper!
lines.caption: Each pair turns into one minus a square, and the chain collapses. Then undo the helper!

lines.text: I'm Vantee. Keep exploring, and I'll see you next time!
lines.caption: I'm Vantee. Keep exploring, and I'll see you next time!
